page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage must be attached externally via network-attached block storage. It does not feature any GPU accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication with other cloud resources and external services.

Given its high resource density of 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, the ecs.g7.32xlarge offers a highly consolidated platform for enterprise workloads. The 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio represents a standard general-purpose configuration, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale applications that require significant compute capacity without needing specialized memory-heavy or GPU-accelerated hardware. Appropriate workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, distributed microservices, and CI/CD pipelines.
